company_name: Xiamen Baoshili Dustless Technology Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — Xiamen Baoshili specializes in cleanroom products essential for semiconductor production and related industries.
summary: Xiamen Baoshili Dustless Technology Co., Ltd. develops and manufactures a range of cleanroom wipes and ultra-clean products that are critical for maintaining contamination control in semiconductor manufacturing. Their offerings include various types of cleanroom wipes and PFA tubes, which are widely utilized in semiconductor production and micro-electronics.

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Xiamen, China, with a self-built factory over 25,000 square meters.
